key_insight: KOAL improves prostate cancer Gleason Grade Group prediction by combining MRI with clinical context, expert knowledge, and ordinal-aware pathology constraints.
clinical_relevance: This could help non-invasively stratify prostate cancer severity from mpMRI, potentially reducing unnecessary biopsies and improving treatment planning.
method: Clinical-Context Modulation uses age and PSA to adapt image feature learning.
Knowledge-Guided Prototype Alignment extracts grade-specific expert anchors from radiology reports and guidelines with an LLM.
Hierarchical Ordinal-aware Constraints predict primary/secondary Gleason patterns and map them to Grade Group with a differentiable logic layer.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports better performance than state-of-the-art methods on public PI-CAI and an in-house dataset.
watch_item: The approach depends on high-quality clinical variables, report-derived knowledge, and external validation before real-world deployment.
paper_title: KOAL: Knowledge-Driven Prostate Cancer Grading with Ordinal-Aware Learning
